output: JSON to stdout only. Exit0 means retained evidence parsed consistently, never permission to continue. Review unresolved and errors; false automatic_resume_allowed/retry_authorized/production_recovery_qualified/controller_enabled are unconditional.
api: inspect(preparation_path, journal_path, io=explicit_read_only_io) -> report; no default IO or observation on import.
journal_contract: Canonical private transaction_root/controller, plan.json exactly matching prepared plan. Host owner binds preparation_digest excluding execution_review.
read_only_io: Allowlisted fixed-label launchctl print, ps identities, lsof listeners, host OS/boot identity and stewardship reads. No service sockets/health/list_handles, signals, administrator requests or lifecycle commands.
durable_boundary: Only signal_intent.wall_time_ns is reported as the final-file timestamp boundary. Missing value remains unresolved; no monotonic-to-wall reconstruction.
immutable_aliases: Only model_snapshot/interpreter group entries can use direct symlinks. Exact link metadata/text and resolved target metadata/hash are checked before/after; transaction records/private directories cannot be symlinks.
limitations: This inspector alone does not qualify production recovery or enable any controller boundary.
Host-operation records have no independent authenticated hash chain; contiguous records/results are cross-checked with the controller chain, and report hashes retain this observation.
It cannot detect a fully rewritten self-consistent history or deleted unanchored tail.
It does not requalify log prefixes, witness semantics, loaded source, numerical restoration or admission state.
Intent-without-result remains unresolved even when current bytes/PID appear consistent with success. Human-reviewed recovery is a separate action, never inferred or retried.
